locator.title: В каких банках можно выгодно купить доллар?
locator.lead: Хотите купить/продать доллар выгодно? Смотрите курсы на Банки.ру!

nearest_text_before.text: Чтобы вам было легче найти, в каких банках сейчас выгодный курс, переходите на сайт Банки.ру!

nearest_text_after.text: Переходите по ссылке, выбирайте предложение, которое вам подходит и нажимайте кнопку "подробнее" — появится список отделений банка с адресами.

image_reading: A smiling couple walks side by side toward the camera, each holding an ice-cream cone upright at chest level.
Exactly three rigid decorative rings sit behind and around the couple at distinct depths; none intersects either person.
The wide composition places the couple prominently against a deep, static city setting.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the article’s upbeat message that comparing exchange offers can make finding a suitable dollar rate feel simple and approachable.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Moving forward together with an easy, confident mood reinforces the article’s promise of a straightforward way to find a suitable dollar-exchange offer.
structured_intent.initial_state: A smiling couple is side by side facing forward, looking warmly at each other while each holds an upright ice-cream cone at chest level.
structured_intent.primary_action: The couple walks forward together in one relaxed, continuous movement.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The couple is visibly farther along their forward walk, still side by side in a natural shared stride, smiling at each other with both cones upright.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: Each person’s hand remains visibly wrapped around the same upright ice-cream cone throughout the movement.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Their warm, confident shared mood remains unchanged through the last frame.

End with the couple visibly farther along their forward walk, still side by side and smiling. Treat all three decorative rings as rigid background graphics locked to their exact source geometry and layering throughout, never crossing either person.
